subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: What trusted dashboard preview boundary should OpenClaw accept for read-only URL embeds now and for later dev-server plus browser-inspection capabilities?
rationale: The request crosses trusted iframe, process lifecycle, browser state, and security-review boundaries, and the only candidate implementation is still an open stacked PR rather than current-main behavior.

options.title: Review phase 1 after stack gates
options.body: Accept the read-only embed, reload, and viewport direction only after the dashboard substrate, proof, and security blockers in the linked PR are resolved.

options.title: Narrow this issue to read-only preview
options.body: Keep this issue scoped to the phase-1 widget and require fresh issues for dev-server lifecycle and browser-backed inspection design.

options.title: Defer the preview widget
options.body: Wait until the broader dashboard/browser security model is settled before accepting even the trusted preview builtin.

recommendation.title: Review phase 1 after stack gates
recommendation.body: Accept the read-only embed, reload, and viewport direction only after the dashboard substrate, proof, and security blockers in the linked PR are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main plugin-tab and related Control UI/security routing signal from code history and prior review context.
